rows.name: Dolorous Flames
rows.heroic:
Adds Good alignment bypass and Flaming. This effect causes the edges of this weapon to burn with enchanted flames, dealing 6d6 Fire damage on each critical hit.

Bug: Dolorous Flames grants Alchemical Fire Attunement and does not grant Flaming.
rows.legendary:
Adds Good alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells have a small chance to deal a large amount of Fire damage.

(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Fire Attunement)

rows.name: Dolorous Chill
rows.heroic:
Adds Chaotic alignment bypass and Freezing. This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 6d6 Ice damage on each critical hit.

Bug: Dolorous Chill grants Alchemical Water Attunement and does not grant Freezing.
rows.legendary:
Adds Chaotic alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells have a chance to inflict ten stacks of Cold damage over time.

(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Water Attunement)

rows.name: Dolorous Sparks
rows.heroic:
Adds Lawful alignment bypass and Jolting. This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 6d6 Lightning damage on each critical hit.

Bug: Dolorous Sparks grants Alchemical Air Attunement and does not grant Jolting.
rows.legendary:
Adds Lawful alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells have a small chance to deal a massive amount of Electric damage.

(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Air Attunement)

rows.name: Dolorous Acid
rows.heroic:
Adds Evil alignment bypass and Corroding. This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with acid, dealing 6d6 Acid damage on each critical hit.

Bug: Dolorous Acid grants Alchemical Earth Attunement and does not grant Corroding.
rows.legendary:
Adds Evil alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells deal a large amount of stacking Acid damage over time.

(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Earth Attunement)
